question: In mammals, Toll-like receptors (TLRs) are receptors:
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Toll-like receptors (TLRs) -> recognize pathogen-associated molecular patterns (PAMPs) -> initiate immune responses -> 80% CHAIN: Toll-like receptors (TLRs) -> activate downstream signaling pathways -> induce the production of pro-inflammatory cytokines -> 85% CHAIN: Toll-like receptors (TLRs) -> play a crucial role in innate immunity -> 80%
analysis: Toll-like receptors (TLRs) are primarily involved in recognizing pathogen-associated molecular patterns (PAMPs) and initiating signaling pathways that lead to the activation of the innate immune response.
